manufacturerIndications.summary: Tendency to put on weight due to faulty activity of the glandular secretion. May also be used to combat incipient goitre. Obesity is a medical condition characterized by excessive accumulation of body fat that presents a risk to health. It is commonly measured using the Body Mass Index (BMI). A BMI of 30 or above is classified as obesity....

safetyNotes: This profile is educational product information, not a diagnosis or prescription.
Medicine selection, potency, repetition and dose should be confirmed by a qualified practitioner.
Do not delay urgent or evidence-based medical care.

manufacturers.name: Dr. Reckeweg & Co. GmbH / Dr. Roshanlal Aggarwal & Sons

products.labelDirections: - 2-3 times daily, in acute conditions 4-5 times, 10-15 drops in a little water. It is recommended to use in the beginning (for 5-6 days) frequent and high doses. Subsequently, take 2-3 times daily 8-10 drops - In children, reduce the dose according to the age (5-8-10 drops) Results vary person to person and overall correction in lifestyle is paramount for good results. Consult your homoeopath physician for any advice.
